description: Canonical evidence kinds (16 total: 12 baseline + 4 AI/ops specialisations). Each kind has a JSON Schema under packages/ontology/schemas/<kind>.schema.json that validates the artefact body.

terms.definition: An approved, published statement of intent and rules adopted by the organisation.
A documented sequence of steps for performing an activity that implements one or more policies.
Machine-generated record of an event with timestamp, actor, action and outcome.
A periodic or ad-hoc document summarising measurements, findings or status for stakeholders.
A point-in-time image of a system's state, used as evidence of configuration or output.
A signed declaration by a named role that a stated condition is true at a stated time.
A captured configuration export (e.g. policy-as-code, IaC, dashboard config) proving the state of a control.
Per-individual evidence of completed training, including curriculum, score and completion date.
Documented record of an incident: detection, classification, response actions, root cause and lessons.
Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment for high-risk AI systems (EU AI Act Art. 27).
Data Protection Impact Assessment for processing likely to result in high risk to data subjects (GDPR Art. 35).
Executed agreement (data-processing addendum, SCC, vendor contract) governing in-scope obligations.
Structured disclosure of an AI model: intended use, training data summary, evaluation results, limitations, owner.
Structured disclosure of a dataset: source, collection method, processing steps, known biases, allowed use.
Tamper-evident export of an audit log segment with hash chain and time bounds.
Periodic certification of who has which privileges on in-scope systems, with attestation by a named reviewer.
